$comment: Pre-stream readiness check (services/studio-ui/readiness.mjs, flag 'readiness', D299 proposed). Every threshold and name the check uses lives here, never in code. status 'proposed' = agent defaults derived as noted below, not yet approved by the user or tuned on a real stream.

disk.source: derived 2026-11-08 from data/outputs/presets/youtube-1080p60.json: H recording 17000 kbps + V recording 7500 kbps (the practice plan records both) = 24.5 Mbps = about 11 GB per hour (gbPerHour, used to say how many hours are left). fail = less than 2 hours of H+V recording left, warn = less than 4 hours. The drive checked is the host's recordings folder (host.info recordingsDir), else the data folder.

otherEncoders.source: process image names, checked 2026-11-08. Meld: tools/soak/stream-day.mjs already looks for MeldStudio*; the exact image name is UNVERIFIED (prefix match). OBS: obs64.exe is the OBS Studio 64-bit image (UNVERIFIED on this PC). A running streaming app can hold NVENC sessions and push to the same stream keys, so Meld and OBS fail (an explicit override can still go live); the others only warn.

bots.source: ports come from the local profile (services/bots loadBotConfig, defaults ws://127.0.0.1:8093 Streamer.bot and :8083 Speaker.bot). A bot that does not answer only warns: the stream itself does not need it (chat feedback, alerts and the spoken test announcement do).

loopback.source: AGENTS.md: never test outputs against real platforms until loopback ffprobe assertions pass. The full CI (tools/ci.mjs, step test-host) runs the host's loopback output tests with ffprobe; a full pass writes a stamp in the git folder (tools/ci-stamp.mjs). Older than maxAgeDays or none = warn.

gpu.source: D1 / AGENTS.md: pin the app to the NVIDIA GPU. host.info reports the libobs adapter name and the Windows graphics preference of the host exe (HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences, GpuPreference=2 is 'High performance'). Adapter not NVIDIA = fail; NVIDIA but no preference stored = warn.

audio.source: D297: the host reports each device audio source in host.status.audioHealth.sources (state ok | starting | missing | inactive | unknown; 'missing' = no audio packets for data/audio/health.json noDataMs). 'method' is only the fallback for a host without audioHealth. 'inactive' (source not in use) neither fails nor warns. Muted sources in the stream mix (mixer.list) warn. While the host answers, audio state that cannot be read (no audioHealth and the method fails, is missing, times out or answers without a sources list) fails (D297 second opinion, 2026-11-08); host down = the host item fails and audio warns. A restarted source stays 'missing' until the new one delivers packets. States verified against app/host/src/studio.cpp Studio::audio_health on 2026-11-08; behaviour with a real dead source UNVERIFIED.

endAll.source: how long 'End all streams' waits for every stream output to report stopped before it answers (the UI server's request timeout is 10 s).
